answer: Each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 575 aliases need 575 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The lantern of the decay is the wall, the ocean of the random walk is the audit, and the sonnet of the distance is public every epoch.
